# Salary Timer

Salary Timer is a free live gross-earnings counter. Enter pay, weekly working days, shift times and unpaid breaks. Settings are saved in the current browser; no account is required.

## Pages

- [Salary Timer homepage](https://salarytimer.work/): live earnings, calculation method, setup instructions and frequently asked questions.
- [Chinese Salary Timer homepage](https://salarytimer.work/zh/): Chinese version of the same live counter and instructions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://salarytimer.work/privacy/): browser-local settings and analytics disclosure.
- [Terms of Use](https://salarytimer.work/terms/): gross-pay estimates, service limits and acceptable use.

## Product limits

Estimates exclude taxes and deductions. Weekly schedules repeat; rotating calendars and specific leave dates are not scheduled automatically. Overtime follows the chosen shift-end multiplier, not automatic legal eligibility. Floating desktop earnings require a supported browser and the original tab to remain open.
